description:
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Dark Depths.
Thespian's Stage triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create a 20/20 Marit Lage legendary creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.
